name: report-merge
description: Atomic admission of distributed report evidence through the real merge_reports API.

actions.init: Construct real SuiteCoverage / ProfileCoverage / CaseEvidence fixtures; no production merge guard patched
actions.reject: profiles.reporting.merge_reports(target, shard with indicated late mismatch), observe actual AssertionError and state
actions.inspect: SuiteCoverage.verified, CaseEvidence.outcomes and retained object references read without mutation

mutants.name: shipped-389c5bb
mutants.description: The exact merge_reports shipped at 389c5bb, before the fix: it writes a shard's earlier cases and new suites into the report before a later mismatch rejects the shard

mutants.name: incremental-admission
mutants.description: Today's merge_reports with its commit loop moved back inside validation, so the same bug returns even after other edits to the function

mutants.name: replace-case-identity
mutants.description: After a compatible merge, a retained case is swapped for an equal copy, so code holding the old object stops seeing new evidence

mutants.name: early-evidence-write
mutants.description: Today's merge_reports with one evidence write (collected) moved inside validation, before a later mismatch can reject the shard

mutants.name: replace-retained-case
mutants.description: Today's merge_reports replacing a retained case with the incoming one instead of extending it

mutants.name: remove-compatibility-guards
mutants.description: Today's merge_reports with every compatibility assertion deleted, so incompatible shards merge silently; the source proof alone would still pass

mutants.name: omit-evidence-commit
mutants.description: Today's merge_reports that validates and then never writes, so compatible evidence is dropped; the source proof alone would still pass

bugs_found.summary: A rejected report shard leaked its earlier cases and new suites into the combined report, which then showed that refused evidence as available
bugs_found.found_by: the historical audit model (audit.qnt, pinned to 389c5bb): its partialPromotionWitnessTest reaches the leak

limits: Two existing suites, one new suite, two cases each; at most six API invocations per trace.
One A profile; passed, failed and incomplete phase payloads; six metadata incompatibilities.
Object identity is checked for previously retained suite/case objects; no transaction, threading or full xdist session proof.
incremental-admission compiles a mutation of the real merge_reports source moving commit inside validation.
replace-case-identity is an explicit post-call output mutation replacing a CaseEvidence object with an equal deep copy; not claimed as original production source.
Historical audit.qnt remains unchanged; broader audit models are not connected contracts.

Additional source mutants compile current merge AST: preflight evidence write, retained case replacement, compatibility guard removal and omitted commit; runtime rejection/accumulation checks complement the conditional source effect theorem.
shipped-389c5bb runs merge_reports-389c5bb.py.txt, the pre-fix function copied verbatim from 389c5bb and pinned by SHA-256 in adapter.py.
